title: 플래넌 섬 등대지기 실종

images.prompt: Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900, stormy night: a small stone lighthouse tower and a low stone cottage on top of a steep black cliff; the lighthouse lantern glass at the top is completely black and unlit, no beam, no glow, the cottage windows also dark; the only light is cold moonlight through storm clouds; wild black sea and white spray below.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: night on a rough sea: a small steamship with warm lit portholes passing far below a black rocky island whose lighthouse tower stands completely dark against the stormy sky.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: a small steam relief ship tossed by huge grey storm waves near towering island cliffs in grey winter daylight, a red signal flare arcing up into the sky above the island, a bare flagpole with no flag on the cliff top.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: one lone lighthouse keeper in an oilskin coat seen from far behind as a small faceless silhouette, climbing long wet stone steps cut into the cliff toward a closed iron gate in a stone wall, the dark lighthouse above, grey windy afternoon.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: inside the keepers' cottage: a tidy plain kitchen with a scrubbed wooden table, plates put away, a cold stove, a wall clock whose hands have stopped, empty chairs, through an open door three neatly made empty narrow beds, cold grey window light.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: the lantern room at the top of the lighthouse: a large polished glass lens gleaming, brass fittings shining, full oil cans lined up neatly, the lamp unlit, cold blue window light, stormy sea through the glass.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: a stone entrance passage inside the cottage with a row of iron wall pegs for oilskins: two pegs completely empty, a pair of boot marks on the stone floor leading to the door, nothing else hanging, dim light.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: the west landing on the island: a concrete landing stage and steep stone steps at the foot of sheer cliffs in a storm, the iron safety railings twisted and bent like soft metal, a high crevice in the rock face above with broken rope ends, sea spray exploding.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: seen from inside a dim stone cottage: the front door wide open onto a howling storm and black sea, and beside the door a single heavy dark wool coat still hanging alone on a wall peg, swaying slightly, the only thing left.

Flannan Isles, a remote rocky island off western Scotland, December 1900: a gigantic white wave surging up the sheer island cliff over the landing stage and the stone steps, enormous spray rising high, grey storm light, nobody there.

Boogi the owl archivist sits at a wooden archive desk at night beside a small amber lantern, an old logbook open in front of him with a tiny sketch of a coat on a peg (any writing blurred and unreadable), a small model lighthouse on the desk, shelves of old books behind.

youtube.title: 한 명은 꼭 남는 등대에서, 셋이 사라졌다
youtube.summary: 1900년 12월, 스코틀랜드 외딴섬. 꺼진 등대에 교대선이 닿았을 때, 등불은 켤 준비가 끝나 있었고 지키던 세 사람은 없었습니다.
youtube.pinned: 외투를 두고 뛰쳐나간 그는, 문밖에서 무엇을 봤을까요?

sources: 출처: National Records of Scotland(2023), Northern Lighthouse Board, 북부등대위원회 감독관 보고서(1901)
hook_type: 규칙×위반(한 명은 남아야 하는데 셋 다)
threads: 1900년 스코틀랜드 외딴섬 등대 얘기. 거기엔 규칙이 있었어. 셋이 지키는데 한 명은 꼭 남아 있어야 한다는 거. 근데 12월 어느 밤, 셋이 다 사라졌어.
폭풍 때문에 교대선은 열하루 뒤에야 도착했고, 등불은 닦여 있고 기름도 가득. 켜기만 하면 되는 상태였대. 시계는 멈춰 있었고.
사라진 옷은 방수복 두 벌뿐. 선착장 내려갈 때 입는 옷. 섬 서쪽 선착장에 가 보니까 쇠 난간이 휘어 있고, 바다 위 33m 바위틈에 둔 밧줄 상자가 통째로 없어졌어.
그리고 문 옆에 외투 한 벌이 그대로 걸려 있었어. 셋째 사람 거. 12월 폭풍 속으로 외투도 없이 뛰쳐나간 거지.
그 사람이 문밖에서 뭘 봤는지는 아무도 몰라. 영상으로 보려면 인스타 @ossak_alarm 에서 봐.
